title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
description: Designs and ships end-to-end web applications across modern React/TypeScript frontends, Node.js or Python REST APIs, databases, and cloud deployments.
interview_topics: REST API auth, caching, and pagination trade-offs
React rendering lifecycle, memoization, and state management
SQL vs NoSQL schema modeling and indexing
System design of a URL shortener or collaborative feed

title: Frontend Engineer
description: Crafts fast, accessible, interactive user interfaces, design systems, and complex browser state architectures using React, TypeScript, and modern CSS.
interview_topics: Browser event loop, closures, and async concurrency
React reconciliation, hooks pitfalls, and bundle splitting
WCAG accessibility, Core Web Vitals, and responsive layout
Frontend system design: autocomplete, virtualized lists, real-time editor

title: Backend Software Engineer
description: Architects reliable, low-latency APIs, distributed services, database schemas, and caching layers powering high-throughput web and mobile platforms.
interview_topics: Database transactions, isolation levels, and B-tree indexing
Caching invalidation patterns and distributed rate limiting
Idempotency, retries, and message queues in microservices
Data structures, graph traversal, and concurrency

title: Generative AI / LLM Engineer
description: Builds production LLM applications, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, structured output systems, and automated evaluation harnesses.
interview_topics: Hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense vectors), chunking, and reranking trade-offs
Designing golden eval suites for RAG faithfulness and hallucination detection
Agentic tool-use loops, structured JSON decoding, and latency/cost budgets
Prompt injection mitigation and production LLM observability

title: Full-Stack AI Product Engineer
description: Bridges product engineering and generative AI to deliver interactive AI copilots, streaming UX, hybrid search backends, and feedback-driven workflows.
interview_topics: Designing streaming AI interfaces with optimistic updates and fallback UX
Orchestrating Node.js gateways with Python ML/LLM inference microservices
Building user-feedback loops to improve recommendations and prompts
Caching, rate limiting, and cost control for LLM-backed APIs

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Designs, trains, evaluates, and deploys supervised, deep learning, and ranking models at scale with rigorous offline/online experimentation.
interview_topics: Bias-variance trade-off, regularization, and feature leakage prevention
PyTorch training stability, loss functions, and inference optimization
End-to-end ML system design (ranking, fraud detection, recommendations)
Online A/B testing, model drift detection, and shadow deployments

title: Recommendation & Search ML Engineer
description: Builds multi-stage candidate generation, semantic retrieval, and personalized ranking systems driving feed discovery, search, and marketplace matching.
interview_topics: Two-tower retrieval vs cross-encoder reranking latency trade-offs
Cold-start mitigation, exploration/exploitation, and popularity bias
Offline metrics (NDCG@K, MRR, Recall@K) vs online engagement metrics
ANN vector indexing (HNSW/IVF) and real-time feature stores

title: NLP & Applied AI Engineer
description: Develops document intelligence, information extraction, semantic search, and fine-tuned language models for unstructured text workflows.
interview_topics: Transformer attention mechanics, tokenization, and context limits
LoRA/QLoRA parameter-efficient fine-tuning vs RAG trade-offs
Evaluating NER, classification, and retrieval pipelines
Serving quantized models with vLLM and batching

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description: Builds object detection, segmentation, OCR, and multimodal visual perception pipelines for robotics, retail, medical imaging, and edge devices.
interview_topics: CNN vs Vision Transformer architectures and transfer learning
Data augmentation, class imbalance, and mAP/IoU metrics
Quantization, ONNX/TensorRT acceleration, and edge deployment
Multimodal VLM alignment and OCR post-processing

title: MLOps & AI Infrastructure Engineer
description: Builds reproducible ML training pipelines, model registries, GPU inference platforms, feature stores, and automated drift monitoring.
interview_topics: CI/CD/CT (continuous training) and reproducible model lineage
Autoscaling GPU inference workloads on Kubernetes
Detecting data drift, concept drift, and silent model degradation
Feature store architecture for online/offline parity

title: Data Scientist
description: Applies statistical modeling, causal experimentation, and predictive machine learning to solve growth, pricing, and retention problems.
interview_topics: Designing A/B tests, sample size calculations, and peeking pitfalls
Interpretable modeling, feature importance, and metric trade-offs
Complex SQL cohort and retention queries
Translating open-ended business problems into measurable KPIs

title: Data Engineer
description: Designs scalable batch and streaming data pipelines, lakehouses, dimensional warehouses, and data quality frameworks.
interview_topics: Dimensional modeling (star schema, SCD Type 2) and warehouse partitioning
Idempotent, backfillable Airflow DAG design and SLA monitoring
Spark memory tuning, data skew, and Parquet file sizing
Batch vs streaming CDC architectures with Kafka

title: Analytics Engineer
description: Transforms raw operational data into clean, tested, documented analytics marts powering BI dashboards and self-serve metrics.
interview_topics: dbt modular layering (staging, intermediate, marts) and testing
Metric definitions, semantic layers, and preventing fan-out joins
SQL window functions and warehouse cost optimization
Partnering with product & finance stakeholders on KPIs

title: Product & Business Data Analyst
description: Uncovers user behavior trends, builds decision-ready executive dashboards, and analyzes funnels and experiments to drive product growth.
interview_topics: Diagnosing sudden drops in conversion or retention metrics
Writing complex SQL aggregations and cohort analyses
Dashboard design clarity and stakeholder storytelling
Experimentation basics and statistical significance

title: DevOps / Cloud Engineer
description: Automates cloud infrastructure, CI/CD release pipelines, container orchestration, and secure deployment workflows for engineering teams.
interview_topics: Terraform state management, modules, and drift detection
Kubernetes pod scheduling, networking, and zero-downtime rollouts
Designing secure CI/CD pipelines with secret management
Linux troubleshooting (CPU, memory, disk I/O, DNS)

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description: Ensures high availability, resilience, latency SLOs, observability, and automated incident response across distributed production systems.
interview_topics: SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and multi-window burn-rate alerting
Debugging cascading failures, thundering herds, and memory leaks
Distributed systems resilience: circuit breakers, bulkheads, backpressure
Blameless postmortems and toil automation

title: Platform Engineer
description: Builds internal developer platforms, golden paths, self-service infrastructure templates, and CI/CD tooling that accelerate engineering velocity.
interview_topics: Designing golden-path templates without creating brittle abstractions
Multi-tenant Kubernetes governance, RBAC, and GitOps (ArgoCD)
Developer experience metrics (DORA) and platform adoption
Infrastructure-as-code testing and safe rollouts

title: Distributed Systems / Core Infrastructure Engineer
description: Engineers fault-tolerant storage engines, consensus protocols, high-throughput messaging brokers, and low-latency core services.
interview_topics: Consensus algorithms (Raft/Paxos), replication, and linearizability
Storage engines (LSM-trees vs B-trees) and write-ahead logs
Concurrency primitives, lock contention, and tail-latency reduction
Network partitions, consistent hashing, and distributed transactions

title: Enterprise Backend Engineer (Java / Spring)
description: Develops mission-critical financial, commerce, and enterprise microservices with Java, Spring Boot, relational databases, and event brokers.
interview_topics: JVM memory model, garbage collection tuning, and concurrency
Spring Boot DI, transactional boundaries, and JPA N+1 issues
Event-driven sagas and outbox pattern with Kafka
Clean architecture and API backward compatibility

title: Cross-Platform Mobile Engineer
description: Builds smooth iOS and Android apps from shared codebases using React Native or Flutter, offline storage, native bridges, and CI release tracks.
interview_topics: React Native new architecture (JSI/Fabric) and 60fps animation performance
Offline-first caching, background sync, and push notifications
Deep linking, app store release automation, and crash telemetry
Handling native module permissions and platform-specific UX

title: iOS Software Engineer
description: Crafts native Apple ecosystem experiences using Swift, SwiftUI, structured concurrency, CoreData, and tight performance profiling.
interview_topics: ARC memory management, retain cycles, and Swift concurrency (async/await, actors)
SwiftUI state flow vs UIKit interoperability
Offline caching, networking resilience, and Instruments profiling
Mobile architecture patterns (MVVM, TCA)

title: Android Software Engineer
description: Develops native Android applications with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, offline persistence, and modular Gradle builds.
interview_topics: Kotlin Coroutines, Flow, and structured concurrency
Jetpack Compose recomposition optimization and lifecycle handling
Room database migrations, WorkManager, and battery efficiency
Modular Android architecture and dependency injection (Hilt)

title: Application Security Engineer
description: Secures web applications, APIs, and AI systems through threat modeling, secure code review, automated SAST/DAST gates, and vulnerability triage.
interview_topics: Exploiting and defending against SSRF, IDOR, XSS, and SQLi
OAuth2/OIDC token flows, JWT pitfalls, and session security
Threat modeling new microservice or LLM features
Integrating SAST/DAST/SCA into CI pipelines with low false positives

title: Cloud Security / DevSecOps Engineer
description: Hardens cloud accounts, Kubernetes clusters, IAM guardrails, and CI/CD supply chains with policy-as-code and continuous detection.
interview_topics: Least-privilege IAM, cross-account roles, and zero-trust VPC design
Container image signing, SBOMs, and Kubernetes Pod Security Standards
Detecting and responding to cloud credential compromise
Policy-as-code enforcement with OPA / Terraform guardrails

title: SDET / QA Automation Engineer
description: Engineers automated testing frameworks, API contract suites, browser E2E checks, and performance benchmarks integrated into CI/CD.
interview_topics: Balancing the test pyramid and eliminating flaky E2E tests
API contract testing, mocking external dependencies, and test data seeding
Load/stress testing API bottlenecks
Embedding quality gates in GitHub Actions pipelines

title: AI / Technical Product Manager
description: Defines AI-native product strategy, user workflows, evaluation criteria, and monetization in close partnership with ML and software engineers.
interview_topics: Deciding when to use deterministic heuristics vs RAG vs fine-tuning
Defining human-in-the-loop UX and acceptable AI error rates
Unit economics of LLM inference tokens and pricing models
Prioritizing roadmap bets using experiment data and user discovery

title: Technical Product Manager
description: Owns product vision, discovery, prioritization, and cross-functional execution for developer platforms, APIs, and customer-facing SaaS.
interview_topics: Product sense: designing a 0-to-1 feature for a target persona
Diagnosing retention funnels and defining North Star metrics
Managing engineering trade-offs, tech debt, and launch sequencing
Writing crisp PRDs and aligning conflicting stakeholders

title: Design Engineer (UI/UX + Frontend)
description: Sits at the intersection of design and frontend engineering, building interactive prototypes, polished micro-interactions, and production design systems.
interview_topics: Translating Figma tokens into accessible, composable React primitives
Motion choreography and 60fps interaction polish
Design system API ergonomics and documentation
Rapid prototyping to validate product hypotheses

title: Cloud & AI Solutions Architect
description: Designs end-to-end cloud, data, and generative AI reference architectures for enterprise customers, balancing security, cost, and latency.
interview_topics: Multi-region HA architecture, RPO/RTO targets, and cloud cost optimization
Enterprise RAG security: tenant isolation, PII redaction, and VPC endpoints
Legacy monolith-to-microservices migration blueprints
Communicating architectural trade-offs to executive stakeholders

title: Real-Time Streaming Data Engineer
description: Builds low-latency event streaming platforms, real-time feature pipelines, and CDC ingestion architectures using Kafka, Flink, and Spark.
interview_topics: Exactly-once vs at-least-once semantics, watermarks, and late-arriving data
Kafka partitioning, consumer group rebalancing, and schema evolution
Real-time feature computation for online ML serving
Backpressure handling and stateful stream checkpointing
